1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and __at least one aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said aero cover is removably attached to said body panel__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __and said at least one aero cover comprises a first aero cover positioned at said first forward corner and a second aero cover positioned at said second forward corner__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __said first aero cover being configured to span and close said first section of open rib structure and said second aero cover being configured to span and close said second section of open rib structure__.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __said transverse ribs being spaced at intervals of between 20mm and 40mm__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __said second plurality of transverse ribs being spaced at intervals of between 20mm and 40mm__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs are configured to provide structural support independent of said aero covers__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are configured to allow selective removal and replacement of said aero covers without damage to said body panel__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, __said buttresses being integrally formed with said body panel__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, __and said open rib structures are configured to be covered by said aero covers during normal vehicle operation__.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover removably attached to said body panel and spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover removably attached to said body panel and spanning and closing said second open rib structure, __wherein said aero covers are selectively removable to provide access to said open rib structures__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, __and said first and second sections are permanently joined to form a unitary structure__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, __and said buttresses extend from the forward edges of said sections__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __said ribs being configured to provide structural reinforcement to said first corner buttress__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __said ribs being configured to provide structural reinforcement to said second corner buttress__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs provide primary structural support independent of said aero covers__.
